mono-2405.d: A cube rendered in 3D with nothing but characters, lit from the right. A cube walks into a terminal. Readable, but not in the usual way.

mono-2421.d: A doughnut rendered in 3D with nothing but characters, lit from the left. The only donut that fits in a terminal. Nerdy in the best sense.

mono-2493.d: A striped sunset over water, typed out in ASCII. Golden hour, monospace edition. Monospace, maximum charm.
